message.content:
Here’s a concise list of the major long‑weekend holidays that Canadians celebrated in 2023.  
(These are the federal statutory holidays; provincial holidays may add a few more dates.)

| Holiday | Date(s) in 2023 | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) – observed Mon 2 | **Jan 1–3** |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | **Feb 18–20** |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | **Apr 7–9** |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | **May 20–22** |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) – observed Mon 3 | **Jul 1–3** |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | **Sep 2–4** |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | **Oct 7–9** |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Saturday) – observed Mon 13 | **Nov 11–13** |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | **Dec 23–25** |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | **Dec 23–26** |

